proposed.sourceName: JAKIM e-SMAF — Muzakarah Jawatankuasa Fatwa MKI, 'Hukum Mengenai Stunning Haiwan' (2005)
proposed.paraphrase: Malaysia's National Fatwa Committee — whose decisions JAKIM publishes in its e-SMAF database and applies in halal certification — rules penetrative and non-penetrative captive-bolt stunning haram outright, permits only head-only electrical stunning within strict limits (0.75 A for goats to 2.0 A for cattle, 3–6 seconds) that must not kill or permanently injure the animal, requires supervision by accredited Muslim officers, and allows waterbath stunning of poultry only where non-lethal — Islamic slaughter with reversible-stun-only controls that meets the mainstream general-halal baseline.
